document.title: Public Judicial Precedents & IP Precedent Pointer Registry
document.authority: Supreme Court of India & High Court IP Divisions

sections.section_title: Section 3(d) / Section 3(p) Judicial Interpretation on Enhanced Efficacy
sections.content: Supreme Court of India binding precedent establishes that mere discovery of a new form of a known substance or known botanical extract without significantly enhanced therapeutic efficacy does not satisfy patentability standards.

sections.section_title: CSIR Defensive Patent Challenges at EPO and USPTO
sections.content: Official international judicial challenges by CSIR using traditional knowledge prior art successfully revoked European and US patent grants on Neem (fungicidal use) and Turmeric (wound healing use).
